name: AIsle0
tagline: Connects ground and flight crews by flight number with live task status during aircraft turnaround.

awards: First Place for American Airlines Challenge

problem: Crews lack shared, real-time visibility into turnaround tasks.
solution: Web and mobile apps share task status per flight (fuelling, completed, restricted), with role-specific inspections, AI hazard tags and an audit log.
demo_moment: Team-described: a crew marks fuelling done and others see it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Place for American Airlines Challenge” among 176 submissions.
Answers the airline challenge on operations.

lessons: Shared status removes the radio call.
